And tonight, the boundary between your world and mine... shatters.|audio = AdminAbuseOpening.ogg|'''Lord Exo's''' opening monologue from the [[Nil Zone]]}} }} ==Description== '''Lord Exo''', or simply just '''EXO''', is the overarching antagonist of the Tower Defense Simulator story. He was first shown in the [[Violent Night Event]]'s game trailer, later making an appearance in the [[Hexscape Event]] as a minor character, and in the [[Null & Void Event]] as the main antagonist. He is a primordial being, one that has existed since the [[Old World]] with his brother,{{InlineQuote|Long ago, two brothers ruled over all creation.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 2 ([[The Narratorium]])}} [[Two X]]. He and his brother were in constant conflict with each other in the [[Old World]]. [[Two X]] wanted to foster creation, but '''Lord Exo''' destroyed those who did not suit his vision. This led to a great war that destroyed much of the [[Old World]], and only '''Lord Exo's''' domain, the [[Nil Zone]], remained. '''Lord Exo''' retained a physical body in the past, but it was destroyed so his soul could be sealed inside the [[God Cube]]. [[Two X]] is stated to be the cause of this, by sacrificing the souls of thousands of his most powerful soldiers, each powerful enough to be worshipped as gods in the [[Overworld]]. It has been stated that '''Lord Exo''' is empowered by stealing the energy of the souls he has under his corruption.{{InlineQuote|Their weapons were drawn—one siphoning the souls of the corrupted and the other was fueled by sacrifice. One takes, the other receives.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 14 ([[The Narratorium]])}} ==Personality== From his initial portrayal in the [[Violent Night Event]] trailer, it can be gathered that '''Lord Exo''' is a calculating villain, observing events as they unfold from the terminal inside the [[God Cube]]. This is further corroborated by his taunting of the [[Scout]] within his nightmares.{{InlineQuote|EVERY UNKNOWING STEP SERVES MY PURPOSE. EACH PAWN PLAYS THEIR PART|'''Lord Exo's''' triumph dialogue ([[Nil Zone]])}} '''Lord Exo''' is shown to be a ruthless killer, as the ending cutscene of [[Blind Faith]] depicts him slaying the downed [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] has also boasted about the millions of living beings that '''Lord Exo''' has slain during the time of the [[Old World]].{{InlineQuote|Meanwhile, '''Lord Exo''' created creatures as tall as buildings while wiping out thousands that didn't suit his vision.
Whoops! Sorry. that was supposed to be *millions*.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 5 ([[The Narratorium]])}} '''Lord Exo''' is also an apathetic individual, discarding those he views to be faulty or ineffective in achieving his goals or interests, such as in the ending cutscene of [[Blind Faith]], where '''Lord Exo''' has no use for [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] anymore, so he discards him from servitude. This can also be backed up by what the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] claims about '''Lord Exo''' in the [[Old World]], stating that he destroyed those who did not meet his vision or interest.{{InlineQuote|Meanwhile,''' Lord Exo''' created creatures as tall as buildings while wiping out thousands that didn't suit his vision. Oh, how I can hear them begging for mercy.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 5 ([[The Narratorium]])}} ==Abilities & Characteristics== {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" ! colspan="2" |Abilities |- |'''Mind Control''': '''Lord Exo''' was likely the perpetrator that brainwashed the elves into turning against [[Santa|Santa Claus]]. However, his methods of achieving this are unknown, along with why he has never been shown to mind-control any other individuals past this event. |[[File:Elvesbuildingmechaclaus.jpg|200px|center|thumb|'''Lord Exo's''' brainwashed elves building the [[Mecha-claus]]]] |- |'''Telekinesis''': On several occasions, '''Lord Exo''' has been shown to telekinetically lift people into the air. The first victim of this ability was in the [[Null & Void Event]], where he lifted the [[Scout]] into the air during his nightmare in [[Outpost 16]], and in [[Blind Faith]], '''Lord Exo''' lifted the [[Dispatcher]] into the air to steal her away from the other agents. Notably, the [[Dispatcher]] was shown to be trapped in purple chains. This is likely a side-effect of '''Lord Exo's''' power being manifested through a physical body. |[[File:LordExoLiftsScout.gif|200px|center|thumb|'''Lord Exo''' lifts the [[Scout]]]]
[[File:LordExoLiftsDispatcher.gif|200px|center|thumb|'''Lord Exo''' lifts the [[Dispatcher]]]] |- |'''Possession''': By forcing out the soul of a suitable vessel's body, '''Lord Exo''' can assume control to fully incarnate into his true form. He has been shown possessing two bodies, the first being the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]'s, which was not suitable enough for him to control, and the second being [[Kronus]]', which was weak enough for him to take over. |[[File:LordExoRipsKronusSoul.gif|200px|center|thumb|'''Lord Exo''' rips out [[Kronus]]'s soul.]] |- ! colspan="2" |Other |- |'''Imprisonment within the God Cube''': From what was revealed in the [[Null & Void Event]], the [[God Cube]] serves as a prison to host '''Lord Exo's''' soul after his original body was destroyed ages ago. |[[File:GodCubeTeaser.gif|200px|center|thumb|"''Made from the souls of thousands that one man sacrificed.''"]] |- |'''Lord Exo's Sword''': In the ending cutscene of [[Blind Faith]], '''Lord Exo''' summoned a sword out of thin air to kill the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]. |[[File:LordExoSword.gif|200px|center|thumb|'''Lord Exo''' kills the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]]] |} ==Story== ===Old World=== Before the [[Old World]] even had a recognizable form, '''Lord Exo''' and [[Two X]], fearing the primordial Void, sealed it away in the deepest reaches of existence so that it could not interfere with them again.{{InlineQuote|Before there was anything to call the [[Old World]], the Void was already waiting in the dark. It cannot be considered a place or a creature, but something else entirely. It is a quiet hunger that lurks beneath the notice of every being, the presence that can be felt when nothing is around. The pale flora that blooms in a place where nothing exists is where it finds its peace. It is of one mind, though it wears a thousand faces. One could call it an incurable infection.
The brothers feared it, and even '''Lord Exo''' and [[Two X]], who feared so little, understood that there was no killing a thing without a body. For the first and final time, they drove it deep down into the foundations of the world, into a dark so total its song could never be heard again.|[[Void Caster]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} Now left alone the from Void, the brothers were left to oversee all of creation in the [[Old World]]. '''Lord Exo's''' interest in seeing what a world would look like bathed in chaos leads him down a terrible path against the wishes of [[Two X]], causing war to break out between the two. This lead to '''Lord Exo''' seeking out the [[Void Caster]], the self-described "''daughter''" of the Void{{InlineQuote|The child was not the Void. The child called it Mother. What she did know was that she was the [[Void Caster]], the daughter of the Void.|[[Void Caster]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} to offer an alliance between the two parties, in defiance of their common enemy of [[Two X]].{{InlineQuote|Once [[Lord Exo]] learned of her existence, he saw an opportunity. He did not trust her so much as he used her. When the war between him and [[Two X]] began, he unearthed the Void and offered a deal to the [[Void Caster]]. She would walk beside him as his prized General, and in return the flora of the Void would take root in every realm and bloom. She still intends to keep that promise.|[[Void Caster]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} As '''Lord Exo's''' follower base grew, so did his army, given to him by the likes of the [[Void Caster]].{{InlineQuote|Before the battle alongside '''Lord Exo''', [[Vindicator]]s would often patrol the ranks of [[Void Caster]]'s army to keep order and offer swift judgement upon those who step out of line.|[[Vindicator]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} At the climax of the final between '''Lord Exo''' and [[Two X]], '''Lord Exo's''' original body was entrapped and destroyed, and his soul was imprisoned within the [[God Cube]] by [[Two X]] through the sacrifice of thousands of his strongest warriors.{{InlineQuote|Where [[Two X]]'s army fought exhaustion, '''Lord Exo's''' never tired. If he didn't end the battle soon, all he wanted to protect would be lost. Looking to his strongest fighters, they willingly sacrificed themselves to create a prison.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 15 ([[The Narratorium]])}} In an unspecified time in the [[Old World]], the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] became [[Lord Exo]]'s servant, later being gifted [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]] by him.{{InlineQuote|I've been beside '''Lord Exo''' long before you came into your worthless existence! (...) He even gave me my beloved hands. Isn't that right, [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]]?|[[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] on Wave 22 ([[Banlands]])}} ===A Dark Tale=== The [[God Cube]] mysteriously appeared in the forest outside [[A Dark Tale|Eclipsed Village]]. Its power beckoned [[The Umbra]], and she touched it, absorbing a portion of its power. However, the [[God Cube]] was shattered in the process, and its fragments were scattered throughout space and time.{{InlineQuote|Shattered pieces scattered around the universe and time has lead to an upbringing of super natural beings.|[https://www.roblox.com/catalog/15169629932/God-Cube-Fragments God Cube Fragments] UGC Accessory Description}} ===Solar Eclipse=== After [[The Umbra]] was defeated by the [[T.D.S. Organization]], the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] was said to have been "''taken''" by '''Lord Exo'''.{{InlineQuote|This entity.. was likely taken by '''EXO''' sometime after we defeated the [[The Umbra|Umbra]]. But what is it doing here?|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 17 ([[Containment]])}} ===Violent Night=== '''Lord Exo''' brainwashed [[Santa|Santa Claus]]'s elves to turn them against him, but the brainwashed elves were then stopped by the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. ===Hexscape=== The [[Children of Exo]] attempted to open a portal from [[Failed Gateway|Eclipsed Village]] to the [[Nil Zone]] to establish a connection to '''Lord Exo''', but were foiled in their efforts by the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. Despite this, they still escape with a shard of the [[God Cube]]. ===Null & Void=== The [[Scout]] had recurring nightmares of [[Lord Exo]] taunting him from within the [[Nil Zone]] about how T.D.S. will be powerless to stop him from invading their world. The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] and the [[Children of Exo]] battled inside the [[Blind Faith|Nil Zone]] for the two halves of the [[God Cube]], and with the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]'s help, the [[Children of Exo]] were victorious. With the [[God Cube]] now merged, the cultists transferred '''Lord Exo's''' soul from within the cube into the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]'s body. However, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] was too powerful for [[Lord Exo]] to consume, so he took over [[Kronus]]'s body instead to fully incarnate into his true form. [[Lord Exo]] kidnapped the [[Dispatcher]] and slew the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], leading to [[Old World|Nil Zone]] rifts being created in other realms. After his return, he was invited to the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]'s premiere; seeing no more use for him, he declined it, making the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] leave him alone. ===The Final Act=== At the end of [[The Final Act Event]], '''Lord Exo''' revoked his power from [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]], killing them, much to the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]'s dismay. In an unknown location, most likely somewhere in the [[Old World|Nil Zone]], '''Lord Exo''' placed [[The Umbra]]'sBethyVA is credited for voicing "''[[The Umbra|Umbra]]''" in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E8Yh_2gQPdo The Final Act cutscenes video] by the developers. As [[The Umbra]] makes no appearances anywhere else, the only possible option is the laugh at the end of the second cutscene. crown on [[Dispatcher]]'s head, hoping for something to happen, but to his disappointment, the [[Dispatcher]] died. However, right after this happens, [[The Umbra]] awoke inside the [[Dispatcher]]'s body and began laughing. LordExoSword.png|Sword used by '''Lord Exo'''. }} ==Trivia== *Originally, the [[Fallen (Story)|Fallen]] were part of '''Lord Exo's''' army, having been mentioned to fight alongside the [[Champion Templar|Champion Templars]] in the [[Old World]]. **After [[v1.85.0]], the lore of the [[Fallen (Story)|Fallen]] was updated alongside the [[Champion Templar|Champion Templars]], leaving the status of their alliance with '''Lord Exo''' to become unclear. *It is possible that '''Lord Exo''' and [[???]] are the same entity. **Before [[v1.85.0]], the [[Hidden Wave]] narrator would have made sense to be '''Lord Exo''' since the [[Fallen (Story)|Fallen]] were mentioned to be directly allied with '''Lord Exo'''. But after the lore of the [[Fallen (Story)|Fallen]] was updated in [[v1.85.0]], it is possible this could no longer be the case. ***All of this only matters if the [[Hidden Wave]] is to be taken as canon, though. *Originally, the [[Champion Templar]]s were part of '''Lord Exo's''' army. They were a group formed through '''Lord Exo's''' gladiatorial battles.{{InlineQuote|Dating back to ancient Robloxian times, the Templar were considered some of the strongest warriors, composed of the fiercest victors from Exo's gladiatorial battles.|[[Champion Templar]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} **Due to the [[Champion Templar]]'s new [[Logbooks|Logbook]] no longer including this and even saying they were part of [[Two X]]'s army,{{InlineQuote|They left their kingdom to join [[Two X]], even if it meant fighting against the people they once swore to protect.|[[Champion Templar]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} the old description is most likely no longer canon. *While '''Lord Exo''' and [[1x1x1x1]] seem to be very similar in terms of appearance, they are not the same character, as stated by a QA tester.https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/608819410383405056/1363614565409230949 **Rather, '''Lord Exo''' is an adaptation of [[1x1x1x1]], as suggested by his backstory. *'''Lord Exo's''' appearances in the [[Lunar Overture Event]] and [[The Classic Event]] are non-canon. ==Notes== {{StoryNavBox}}
